description: Create a collection in the signed-in user’s stream deck from existing Synoptic streams and return collection metadata. Automatically follows eligible selected sources and may consume invitations; backfills matching stored posts. Optional saved AI filters process incoming posts and can use the account’s AI allowance. Repeated successful calls create separate collections. Does not purchase stream access or create upstream collectors.

filters.description: Optional include/exclude keywords, /pattern/flags regex, and highlighting settings. The ai value is an existing saved filter ID from list_ai_filters; using it can consume the account’s AI allowance. Defaults to no filters.

ai.description: AI filter ID from list_ai_filters to apply to incoming posts

excludeKeywords.description: Drop posts matching any field set here: all drops posts containing every word, any drops posts containing any of them, phrase drops posts containing the phrase

all.description: Space-separated words; a post matches when its text contains every word

any.description: Space-separated words; a post matches when its text contains at least one word

phrase.description: Exact phrase; a post matches when its text contains it

highlightColor.description: Synoptic app color for text matching includeKeywords and regex: one of lightYellow, lightOrange, lightTeal, lightBlue, yellow, green, blue, red, orange, purple

includeKeywords.description: Keep only posts matching every field set here; matching is case-insensitive

all.description: Space-separated words; a post matches when its text contains every word

any.description: Space-separated words; a post matches when its text contains at least one word

phrase.description: Exact phrase; a post matches when its text contains it

isHighlightEnabled.description: Highlight text matching includeKeywords and regex in the Synoptic app

regex.description: Keep only posts whose text matches this /pattern/flags regex

highlights.description: Optional enabled state and regex/color rules for highlighting matching text.

values.description: Rules that mark matching post text with a color

color.description: Synoptic app color for matching text: one of lightYellow, lightOrange, lightTeal, lightBlue, yellow, green, blue, red, orange, purple

matchingSourcesOnly.description: Restrict the collection’s source picker to streams with market matching. Defaults to false.

name.description: Display name for the new collection.

sources.description: Existing Synoptic stream IDs. For followed custom-target streams, customTargets narrows saved selections; omit it to use all saved targets. Stream owners receive all targets. Optional sourceIds narrows to known constituent source IDs already routed to the stream; omit it for all sources.

customTargets.description: For a followed custom-target stream, the saved targets to include, from get_stream_custom_targets; omit for all of them. Not allowed on other streams; ignored on streams the user owns, which include every target

sourceIds.description: Source IDs already routed to this stream to include, such as a post’s sourceId; omit or [] for every source

streamId.description: Synoptic stream ID from search or streams_all

streamDeckId.description: ID of a stream deck owned by the signed-in user, from list_stream_decks.

aiFilterId.description: Attached AI filter ID for get_ai_filter; null when none

columnWidth.description: Column width in pixels from set_collection_column_width; null when unset
